title: Outlier-Robust Diffusion Solvers for Inverse Problems
abstract: arXiv:2605.09477v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Methods based on diffusion models (DMs) for solving inverse problems (IPs) have recently achieved remarkable performance. However, DM-based methods typically struggle against outliers, which are common in real-world measurements. In this work, to tackle IPs with outliers, we first refine the measurement via explicit noise estimation to mitigate the effect of noise. Subsequently, we formulate an iteratively reweighted least squares objective based on the Huber loss to address the outliers. We propose a method utilizing gradient descent to approximately solve the corresponding optimization problem for the robust objective. To avoid delicate tuning of the learning rate required by the gradient descent method, we further employ the conjugate gradient method with an efficient strategy for updating. translated_title: 面向逆问题的鲁棒离群值扩散求解器
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.09477v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：基于扩散模型（DMs）的逆问题（IPs）求解方法近年来取得了显著性能。然而，基于DM的方法通常难以应对离群值，而离群值在现实世界测量中很常见。在这项工作中，为了解决带有离群值的逆问题，我们首先通过显式噪声估计来细化测量，以减轻噪声的影响。随后，我们基于Huber损失构建了一个迭代重加权最小二乘目标，以处理离群值。我们提出了一种利用梯度下降的方法来近似求解针对鲁棒目标的相应优化问题。为了避免梯度下降方法所需的学习率精细调整，我们进一步采用了共轭梯度方法，并配以高效的更新策略。在多个图像数据集上针对线性和非线性任务在各种条件下的广泛实验表明，我们提出的方法...
tldr: 本文提出了一种鲁棒的离群值扩散求解器，通过显式噪声估计和基于Huber损失的迭代重加权最小二乘目标，结合共轭梯度方法，有效解决了逆问题中的离群值干扰。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an outlier-robust diffusion solver that mitigates outlier effects in inverse problems via explicit noise estimation and a Huber-loss-based iteratively reweighted least squares objective, solved efficiently with conjugate gradient.
